Which of the following can most reasonably be inferred from the passage?

options.A: The state produces most of its electricity from coal.
options.B: The cashback offer was followed by more consumers paying online.
options.C: Payment counters will close permanently across the state.
options.D: Counter payments grew faster than online payments.

stem:
Last quarter, a food-delivery platform recorded a 9% increase in late-night orders while lunchtime orders declined slightly. The change followed the introduction of free delivery after 10 p.m.. A local festival during the same quarter may also have affected the figures, and management cautions against firm conclusions.

Which of the following can most reasonably be inferred from the passage?

options.A: Restaurants will stop serving lunch in the city.
options.B: Free late-night delivery coincided with more late-night ordering.
options.C: Lunchtime orders rose sharply after the offer began.
options.D: The platform's head office is in another state.

Last quarter, a regional airline recorded a 31% increase in early-morning bookings while late-evening bookings declined slightly. The change followed the introduction of discounted fares on morning flights. A local festival during the same quarter may also have affected the figures, and management cautions against firm conclusions.

Which of the following can most reasonably be inferred from the passage?

options.A: The airline's pilots have the most flying hours in the industry.
options.B: Late-evening bookings increased more than early-morning bookings.
options.C: Fare discounts were followed by more travellers choosing morning flights.
options.D: Evening flights are no longer profitable for any airline.

Last quarter, a university canteen recorded a 18% increase in salad sales while fried-snack sales declined slightly. The change followed the introduction of a new nutrition-labelling display. A local festival during the same quarter may also have affected the figures, and management cautions against firm conclusions.

Which of the following can most reasonably be inferred from the passage?

options.A: Fried-snack sales rose sharply after the display was installed.
options.B: Displaying nutrition information may have shifted some purchases towards salads.
options.C: The canteen is run by a national catering company.
options.D: Students will stop eating fried snacks altogether.

Which of the following can most reasonably be inferred from the passage?

options.A: The service uses only electric vehicles.
options.B: The cheaper hourly tariff was associated with more hourly bookings.
options.C: Full-day bookings increased more than hourly bookings.
options.D: No customer will ever book a car for a whole day again.

options.A: The museum's collection is the oldest in the country.
options.B: Weekend-morning ticket sales increased after the change.
options.C: Families no longer visit museums at weekends.
options.D: Opening late on Thursdays attracted additional evening visitors.

options.A: Afternoon attendance rose more than early-morning attendance.
options.B: The early-bird discount was followed by more swimmers coming early in the morning.
options.C: Nobody swims in the afternoon any more.

Which of the following can most reasonably be inferred from the passage?

options.A: The newspaper has won several journalism awards.
options.B: Print subscriptions grew after the package was introduced.
options.C: Printed newspapers will vanish from the region within a year.
options.D: The bundled digital package coincided with growth in digital subscriptions.

Which of the following can most reasonably be inferred from the passage?

options.A: Longer opening hours are associated with more evening visits.
options.B: Morning visitors no longer value the library.
options.C: The library has the largest collection in the state.
options.D: Morning visits rose after the change.

Last quarter, an online grocery store recorded a 18% increase in subscription orders while one-time orders declined slightly. The change followed the introduction of a discounted monthly plan. Management has not yet studied whether other factors were involved.

Which of the following can most reasonably be inferred from the passage?

options.A: The store's delivery drivers are paid above the market rate.
options.B: One-time orders will disappear entirely within a year.
options.C: Some customers moved from one-time purchases to the discounted plan.
options.D: One-time orders increased after the plan was launched.

A local festival during the same quarter may also have affected the figures, and management cautions against firm conclusions.

Which of the following can most reasonably be inferred from the passage?

options.A: Nobody in the city will take long cycling trips again.
options.B: Pricing changes influenced the length of trips riders chose.
options.C: Long-trip rentals grew faster than short-trip rentals.
options.D: The city has more cars per person than any other city.
